notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('module://matplotlib_inline.backend_inline')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.linalg import solve_continuous_are, solve_discrete_are, solve_continuous_lyapunov
np.set_printoptions(precision=9, suppress=True)

cells.code:
# 双积分器、标量、LQG主例与习题1/6
A = np.array([[0.,1.],[0.,0.]])
B = np.array([[0.],[1.]])
C = np.array([[1.,0.]])
Q = np.eye(2); R = np.eye(1)
P = solve_continuous_are(A.T,C.T,Q,R)
Kf = np.linalg.solve(R,C@P).T
residual = A@P+P@A.T-P@C.T@np.linalg.solve(R,C@P)+Q
print('double_P_Kf_poles', P, Kf.ravel(), np.linalg.eigvals(A-Kf@C))
print('ARE_residual', np.linalg.norm(residual))
assert np.allclose(P, [[np.sqrt(3),1],[1,np.sqrt(3)]])
assert np.linalg.norm(residual)<1e-10
for a,q,r in [(-1,1,1),(-2,3,1),(-1,1,1),(-2,2,1)]:
    p = r*(a+np.sqrt(a*a+q/r))
    print('scalar_a_q_r_p_k_pole', a,q,r,p,p/r,a-p/r)
K = np.linalg.solve(R,B.T@solve_continuous_are(A,B,Q,R))
M = np.block([[A-B@K,B@K],[np.zeros((2,2)),A-Kf@C]])
print('unit_LQG_K_poles',K,np.linalg.eigvals(M))

# 习题2同噪声下的极点配置与Kalman；题4/10边界核对
A2=np.array([[0.,1.],[-2.,-3.]])
P2=solve_continuous_are(A2.T,C.T,np.eye(2),R)
Lk=P2@C.T; Lp=np.array([[8.],[4.]])
print('exercise2_P_K',P2,Lk.ravel())
for label,L in [('Kalman',Lk),('placed',Lp)]:
    F=A2-L@C
    Sigma=solve_continuous_lyapunov(F,-(np.eye(2)+L@L.T))
    print('exercise2_poles_trace',label,np.linalg.eigvals(F),np.trace(Sigma),Sigma)
    assert np.linalg.norm(F@Sigma+Sigma@F.T+np.eye(2)+L@L.T)<1e-10
# 三工况：固定极点基线唯一，不额外调参；第三组透明构造为持平
for label,Qcase in [('low',.1*np.eye(2)),('nominal',np.eye(2)),('tie',np.array([[56.,50.],[50.,92.]]))]:
    Pc=solve_continuous_are(A2.T,C.T,Qcase,R)
    Lc=Pc@C.T; Fp=A2-Lp@C
    Sc=solve_continuous_lyapunov(Fp,-(Qcase+Lp@Lp.T))
    print('exercise2_three_cases',label,np.trace(Pc),np.trace(Sc))
    assert np.trace(Pc)<=np.trace(Sc)+1e-10
    if label=='tie': assert np.allclose(Lc,Lp)
Pdeg=np.diag([1.,0.]); Fdeg=A-Pdeg@C.T@C
print('exercise4_P_poles',Pdeg,np.linalg.eigvals(Fdeg))
assert np.linalg.norm(A@Pdeg+Pdeg@A.T-Pdeg@C.T@C@Pdeg+np.diag([1.,0.]))<1e-10
S=solve_continuous_are(A,B,np.diag([10.,1.]),R)
K10=B.T@S
M10=np.block([[A-B@K10,B@K10],[np.zeros((2,2)),A-Kf@C]])
print('exercise10_S_K_control_poles_all',S,K10,np.linalg.eigvals(A-B@K10),np.linalg.eigvals(M10))
assert np.allclose(np.poly(M10),np.polymul(np.poly(A-B@K10),np.poly(A-Kf@C)),atol=1e-10)

notebooks.title: 连续噪声增量仿真
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('module://matplotlib_inline.backend_inline')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.linalg import solve_continuous_are, solve_discrete_are, solve_continuous_lyapunov
np.set_printoptions(precision=9, suppress=True)

cells.code:
# 连续状态/观测增量一致的Euler-Maruyama仿真
A=np.array([[0.,1.],[0.,0.]])
C=np.array([[1.,0.]])
P=solve_continuous_are(A.T,C.T,np.eye(2),np.eye(1))
K=P@C.T
dt=.005; steps=2000; t=np.arange(steps+1)*dt
def simulate(seed):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    x=np.zeros((steps+1,2)); xhat=x.copy()
    x[0]=[1.,0.]; xhat[0]=[.5,0.]
    dy=np.zeros(steps)
    for k in range(steps):
        dw=rng.standard_normal(2)*np.sqrt(dt)
        dv=rng.standard_normal()*np.sqrt(dt)
        dy[k]=(C@x[k]).item()*dt+dv
        x[k+1]=x[k]+A@x[k]*dt+dw
        xhat[k+1]=xhat[k]+A@xhat[k]*dt+K.ravel()*(dy[k]-(C@xhat[k]).item()*dt)
    return x,xhat,dy
rmses=[]
for seed in range(5):
    x,xhat,dy=simulate(seed)
    rmses.append(float(np.sqrt(np.mean((x[:,0]-xhat[:,0])**2))))
print('simulation_grid',len(t),t[0],t[-1],dt)
print('simulation_RMSE_seeds_0_to_4',rmses)
assert len(t)==2001 and t[-1]==10 and np.isfinite(rmses).all()

# 展示seed0；观测除以dt只是有噪声的区间平均读数
x,xhat,dy=simulate(0)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(8,7),sharex=True)
axes[0].plot(t,x[:,0],label='true position')
axes[0].plot(t,xhat[:,0],label='estimated position')
axes[0].plot(t[:-1],dy/dt,alpha=.15,label='interval observation')
axes[1].plot(t,x[:,1],label='true velocity')
axes[1].plot(t,xhat[:,1],label='estimated velocity')
axes[2].plot(t,x[:,0]-xhat[:,0],label='position error')
for ax in axes: ax.legend(); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
axes[2].set_xlabel('time (s)'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print('simulation_seed0_final_state_estimate',x[-1],xhat[-1])

import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('module://matplotlib_inline.backend_inline')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.linalg import solve_continuous_are, solve_discrete_are, solve_continuous_lyapunov
np.set_printoptions(precision=9, suppress=True)

cells.code:
# 一次离散融合与假设失配的解析真实风险
prior=20.; pminus=4.; y=23.; r=1.
k=pminus/(pminus+r); post=prior+k*(y-prior)
pplus=(1-k)**2*pminus+k*k*r
print('one_update_K_mean_variance',k,post,pplus)
assert np.allclose([k,post,pplus],[.8,22.4,.8])
for qa in [.01,1.,100.]:
    k=-1+np.sqrt(1+qa)
    actual=(1+k*k)/(2*(1+k))
    print('mismatch_qa_K_nominal_actual',qa,k,k,actual)
print('scalar_limit_stable_unstable',-1+abs(-1),1+abs(1))

# 习题7：每拍独立恒定随机加速度，不冒充连续白噪声
Ad=np.array([[1.,1.],[0.,1.]])
C=np.array([[1.,0.]])
Gd=np.array([[.5],[1.]])
Qd=.25*Gd@Gd.T; Rd=np.array([[1/900.]])
Pi=solve_discrete_are(Ad.T,C.T,Qd,Rd)
innovation=C@Pi@C.T+Rd
K=np.linalg.solve(innovation,C@Pi).T
I=np.eye(2); post=(I-K@C)@Pi@(I-K@C).T+K@Rd@K.T
F=(I-K@C)@Ad
print('exercise7_Qd_Rd',Qd,Rd)
print('exercise7_prior_posterior_K_poles',Pi,post,K.ravel(),np.linalg.eigvals(F))
assert np.linalg.norm(Pi-(Ad@post@Ad.T+Qd))<1e-10
assert np.min(np.linalg.eigvalsh(post))>=0 and np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(F)))<1
print('all_numeric_checks_passed')
